length_basis: Display-only actual neutral GLB X extent; model_scale1 preserves source body.axis.l metres. Not measured specimen TL.

reference_anatomy.body_axis_definition: Original paper/package body.axis.l; CSV header FL_m retained separately, not silently relabelled TL/SL.

reference_provenance.author: Ryosuke Motani
reference_provenance.source_type: University-associated real-animal digitization, orthographic silhouette derivative. Specimen age/sex unknown; small specimen, not an adult250cm proportion standard.
reference_provenance.body_axis_csv_header: FL_m; paper code calls body.axis.l. Do not relabel as TL/SL.

TL_from_figure2_scale_bar.uncertainty: Low-resolution published figure and manual endpoints; around60cm, not calibrated3D TL.

reference_anatomy.transverse_body_symmetry: Average the two actual silhouette sides around their local midpoint; source width retained. Does not recover unseen3D cross-section.

cross_section_and_head_thickness.body_section: elliptical cross-section representation between measured lateral/ventral outer envelopes; internal3D section shape is unknown

head_thickness_source.evidence: Previously accepted generated front artwork; projected style constraint, not measured biological normal thickness.

source.evidence: Previously accepted generated ventral artwork, actual viewed mouth arc; auxiliary shape hypothesis only. Gap/depth are explicit engineering trials. Full native lip material and real specimen mouth verification remain pending.

reference_anatomy.scope: Static head/body/oral trial at reference scale; no adult250cm replacement, no complete fins/rig/motion or user acceptance. Geometry representation and mouth engineering choices are explicit, not biological tissue measurements.

placement_basis.reference: Motani2023 Fig2A/2B; actual Sphyrna_lewini planar masks, common pixel scale as stated paper Input section
placement_basis.kind: Manual approximate specimen-pose engineering registration; fin root surface is actual finite body, normal thickness is NOT measured animal data
placement_basis.known_conflict: Generic example labelled S.tudes excluded. Root onset fractions/roll are this trial choices, not copied biological measurements. Caudal mask is rotated45deg into actual Fig2A orientation.

fin_template_parameters.thickness_basis: Current trial values per fin, continuous single ridge and root-to-tip taper. Published NACA modelling percentages are adjustable modelling assumptions, not measured normal tissue thickness. First dorsal front projection constrains order of magnitude only.
fin_template_parameters.scope: Same-species validation masks. Placement/roll and normal thickness are declared engineering pose choices checked against published orthogonal figure; no unseen tissue metrology. Generic Sphyrna example parameters are not imported. Whole-fish source/material/rig/pose gates remain pending.

mouth_parameters.source_annotation_scope: Manually traced dark mouth edges in original ventral image, native620px head span. Exterior lip widths3/4px; native-only core, fade outside. Generated reference, not biological dimensions.

base_donor_map.scope: Nearest opaque interior head skin only for derived preview base. Native lip sampling bypasses this fallback and must be opaque at exact traced donor.

gill_chart.scope: Already painted five slits, opaque RGB source exact in core. Alpha is a semantic transfer mask only; body stays opaque. No extra drawn slit or 3D slit-depth claim.

mouth_parameters.gill_placement_basis: Five actual own-source painted slits; fit laterally between cephalofoil root and pectoral region. Axial0.16..0.216 and verticalfraction0.25..0.88 are target feature retargeting, not specimen measurements. Lateral support excludes back/belly.

current_eye_parameters.basis: Art-scale native eye, source radius23px; placement from near-terminal0.96span chord and actual finite head surface at every lens sample. Closed conforming front/back lens,0.10..0.55mm outward offset and0.15mm inward backing. No extremum-as-eye-center or flat end cap; not a measured biological eyeball.

current_body_support_parameters.reason: Share every cap support in the posterior body_06..07 interval, where the unsupported long-body-triangle LBS error occurred. Full181-vertex tail basal domain remains unchanged and is checked in every pose; anterior cap not reselected or exempted. Eye spokes12 to10 reserves32tri for structural support under4000.

current_rig_parameters.motion_basis: New own-cage small-reference display motion. General carcharhiniform posterior body/caudal drive and stiff continuous foils; amplitudes/frequency are engineering display settings, not S.lewini measured kinematics. Prior C.limbatus proxy remains a proxy, not transferred as this specimen measurement. Full native/four-action/control-range collision and visual validation required.

notes: Own 18-bone sparse reference specimen, 3986 whole triangles. Full native loop 44/24 seconds.
Display length is the actual neutral GLB X extent; model scale=1 preserves the reference body.axis.l metres. This is not a measured TL of the source specimen.
Amplitudes/frequency are conservative engineering display settings, not measured S.lewini kinematics. Shared carcharhiniform posterior-drive rationale is a qualitative proxy.
Candidate only; full current root/membrane, GPU visual, mouth/body/head and SOP gates remain mandatory.

unknowns: Source age and sex unknown; approximately60cm specimen does not establish adult250cm proportions.
Head foil thickness, fin thickness/tilt/onsets, eye size, oral gap/depth and motion amplitudes are source-art or engineering choices, not tissue/kinematic measurements.
Native lips/eyes/gills/main fin interiors and derived de-lit body/edge/seal/tail-attachment skin are declared separately.

Whole production SOP, canonical game installation, same-canvas whole-source audit, three-distance/actual-LOD review and underwater orbit/action video remain separate from these current technical checks.
scope: Complete anatomy/native-rig standalone review candidate. No whole-fish formal acceptance, no user appearance acceptance and no canonical installation.
